summary_md:
# Superveckan är här!

**Feed**: kort-och-lang  
**Published**: 2026-10-19  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This is Dagens Industri's Kort och lång preview of the busiest week of the Q3 2026 Swedish reporting season. Hosts Robert Andersson and Julia Forsberg Thulin go through early profit warnings (Truecaller, Catena Media) and the key reports ahead from ABB, Byggmax, SKF, Mips, Atlas Copco, Axfood, Volvo and Saab. Their view is mixed: they worry about AI and data-center sentiment cooling and about high valuations (ABB, Saab), but they see upside in low-expectation names such as Byggmax, Mips and SKF.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 MIPS — Mips | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Host personal favourite, 'ganska bullish' ahead of Q3 after 42% organic growth and legal settlement.

#### Reasoning

Legal overhang removed after summer settlement. Q2 showed 42% organic growth and about 9pp margin expansion thanks to operating leverage on fixed costs. Comps are fairly easy, so if growth and margin hold there is more upside. The risk is US consumer weakness, since Mips sells heavily in the US.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Q3 growth decelerates sharply
- if US consumer demand weakens materially
- if cash is diverted to non-core uses

> *"Om man kan hålla en liknande tillväxttakt och marginalförstärkning tror jag att det finns en hel del kvar att hämta i Mips. Jag är ganska bullish."*

---

### 🟠 BMAX — Byggmax | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Q3 may beat earlier cautious signals; LFL +3.7% consensus, margin seen rising, easier H2 comps.

#### Reasoning

Consumer optimism is improving, so Q3 may beat management's cautious tone from Q2. Consensus expects 3.7% LFL growth and EBIT margin up from 13.3% to 14.0%. Cost control is good and H2 comps are easy. Analyst coverage is thin, and big-ticket renovation demand is still sluggish.

#### Sell Triggers

- if LFL sales turn negative
- if large-project demand remains weak

> *"Det ser ut som att det kan bli ett ganska bra kvartal för Byggmax."*

---

### 🟠 SKF-B — SKF | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 45%

Last report before spin-off; estimates trimmed but low valuation (EV/EBIT ~11) means a small surprise could trigger trend break.

#### Reasoning

Four straight negative report-day reactions, estimates cut ahead of the report and only 4% expected growth are all red flags. Against that, the valuation is depressed, so even a small surprise could lift the stock. The automotive spin-off (listing 1 Dec) and Cevian's next moves may drive flows, but the auto unit could get a very low multiple.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Q3 disappoints for fifth straight report
- if Cevian sells down after spin-off
- if automotive unit valued very low

> *"det inte krävs en jättestor överraskning när multipeln är så låg för att det ska kunna bli ett trendbrott och en positiv kursreaktion"*

---

### 🟡 AXFO — Axfood | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Gut feel weak Q3 as Willys loses share amid price wars; returning food inflation could help ahead.

#### Reasoning

Willys has grown slower than the market for two quarters, and Ica and Coop are cutting prices. The host expects a weak Q3. Further out, returning food inflation (energy, El Niño, possible VAT reinstatement) favours the discounter. City Gross needs to turn profitable in H2 2026.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Willys keeps losing market share
- if City Gross fails to reach profitability in H2 2026
- if price war intensifies

> *"Magkänslan säger att tredje kvartalet blir ganska svagt."*

---

### 🟡 SAAB-B — Saab | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 45%

Strong Q3 expected but high valuation; downside larger than upside on disappointment; cash flow key.

#### Reasoning

Consensus expects 26% growth and 58bn of orders, including Gripen E for Ukraine, and analysts have raised Dynamics estimates. Cash conversion is the recurring worry, and comps get tougher after this quarter. The high valuation means the risk/reward is skewed to the downside on a miss. Mildef's positive warning is supportive.

#### Sell Triggers

- if cash flow disappoints
- if order intake below 58bn expectation
- if growth slows on tougher comps

> *"Nedsidan är nog större än uppsidan om det skulle bli en stor besvikelse kontra en positiv överraskning."*

---

### 🟡 VOLV-B — Volvo | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Neutral | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Host cautious: limited Q3 upside, slowing growth; needs ~12% margin or positive 2027 outlook to lift.

#### Reasoning

The re-rating is seen as deserved, but growth is slowing and margin expansion is fading. Consensus expects 11.8% margin against 11.7% a year ago and sales down 1%. The 2027 market outlook is the main catalyst; Deutsche Bank expects North America +9% and Europe -2%.

#### Sell Triggers

- if 2027 market outlook disappoints
- if margin falls short of 11.8%

> *"Hur stor är uppsidan inför tredje kvartalet? Kanske inte alltför stor."*

---

### 🟠 ABB — ABB | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 45%

Strong demand (Schneider peer read-across) but very high valuation; every parameter must be strong.

#### Reasoning

Orders are expected to grow 33% this year, and Schneider's strong data-center results are a positive read-across. Last quarter the stock fell on margin despite strong orders. Valuation is very high amid AI jitters, so margin and outlook must both deliver. The Rotork deal adds uncertainty.

#### Sell Triggers

- if operating margin misses again
- if data-center demand slows
- if Rotork integration commentary disappoints

> *"Alla parametrar i rapporter måste vara starka för att det ska lyfta."*

---

### 🟠 ATCO-A — Atlas Copco | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 45%

Peers strong, vacuum orders expected +50%; could raise cautious outlook; AI-chain doubts key risk.

#### Reasoning

Atlas Copco broke its eight-quarter negative report-day streak last time on strong vacuum orders. Peers point to strong demand, and Q3 orders are seen +18% with vacuum +50%. Management may lift its unchanged outlook. It needs to show that AI-chain weakness is noise.

#### Sell Triggers

- if vacuum order growth falls well short
- if outlook stays cautious amid AI slowdown

> *"Man kanske nu vågar uppdatera sina prognoser och tro på en bättre framtid."*

---

### 🟠 TRUE-B — Truecaller | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Up to SEK 900m Indian tax hit erodes balance-sheet cushion and dividends, offset by strong preliminary Q3.

#### Reasoning

The Indian transfer-pricing dispute could cost up to 900m, which is several years of profit, and has to be reserved. That removes the strong balance sheet that was the stock's main support and limits dividends. On the other side, preliminary Q3 shows a better ad market and a rebound in enterprise growth. The market is split, with the stock opening +10% and fading to +1%.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Indian tax ruling confirms full 900m liability
- if dividend capacity cut
- if enterprise growth reverses

> *"Det är svårt vilket ben man ska stå på. Marknaden känner nog detsamma."*

---
